functions.purpose: 2D-grid config accessor for CLevelEnSubGroupRewardInfo (entrust sub-group reward table). Resolves the singleton InfoManager (lazy FindByName fallback DAT_123c003c) then indexes the shared CInfoManager grid by a level/reward id, returning the entry pointer.
formulas: shared CInfoManager 2D-grid lookup: valid iff param!=-1 && (param!=0 || base[+0x30]==0) && cols[+0x28]!=0; idx = param - base[+0x30]; valid iff 0<=idx<count[+0x24]; row = grid[+0x20][idx / cols]; result = row[idx % cols] (row==0 -> return 0)
container offsets: +0x20 row-array, +0x24 element count, +0x28 columns/stride, +0x30 base/first-id (same layout confirmed in schema item.md GetLevelByExp)
functions.serverRelevance: authoritative: read-only accessor over server-loaded static reward config; server owns the CLevelEnSubGroupRewardInfo table and the reward ids it yields.

formulas: same CInfoManager grid formula as 1095c0d0: idx=param-base[+0x30]; row=grid[+0x20][idx/cols[+0x28]]; result=row[idx%cols]; guards param!=-1, cols!=0, 0<=idx<count[+0x24]
functions.serverRelevance: authoritative: read-only accessor over server-loaded appraisal reward-box config.

formulas: nLimitEnterCount = FUN_1130cb50(argIdx=9) + FUN_1130cb50(argIdx=5) (two TLV int args summed at 0x10975727-0x10975764)

appraiseArr max value iVar4 = max over up-to-3 appraisal slots of FUN_1141bcc0(piVar3[4]->vtbl[+0x1c]()) where result>=0; stored per slot keyed by CLevelInfo grid offsets +0x30/+0x34/+0x38 (FUN_1184c850)

requirement fields read by TLV arg-index (FUN_1130bb80(idx)): idx0xe->needLev, idx8->mLimitMember/mLimitMemberMax(+4/+8), idx0xd->needItemId/needItemCount, idx5->needGuildLev + nCurrentGuildLev(guild+0x44), idx4->needGoldenHunterLev + nCurrentGoldernLev, idx0xc->nTicketCount
bIsFastestPass path: only when levelInfo+0x2e34 != 0; nFastestPassTime = *(short*)psVar10; strFastestPassName from psVar10+4

bIsAccept/progress via CMHLevelInfo::CheckLevelProgressThreshold; cleared to 0 if pcVar8+0x14 == 0x4b2 (level id 1202)
costs: playerMoney = FUN_1025b060() (unbound currency getter), playerBoundMoney = second FUN_1025b060 read; both snapshotted into VO for display

functions.purpose: Builds the hub-page level list VO (param_5==7). Depending on selector local_19c (1=entry,4=raid,2=king,3=letter,5=star-level,7=other) calls CMHLevelInfo::CollectHub*Configs, then per level writes many display fields (levelID, levelMod, levelShowType, levelLockType, isReward, isStarHunt, appraisal, bDoubleReward, maxLimited, isElite, unlock conditions, next-level indices, BossName/LevelName).
formulas: selector dispatch on local_19c: 1->CollectHubEntryConfigs, 4->CollectHubRaidConfigs, 2->CollectHubKingQuests, 3->CollectHubLetterQuests, 5->CollectHubPageStarLevelQuests, 7->FUN_1130bcd0

per-level element stride = 0x20 dwords (0x80 bytes): fields at [0]=levelID, [1]=levelMod, [2]=levelPointIndex, [4]=isValidLevel/levelShowType, [5]=levelDifficultType, [6]=levelIconName-related, [0xc]=levelLockType, [0xd]=maxLimited, +0x1d(byte)=isElite-flag, [0x14/0x15]=unlock-condition range, [0x17/0x18]=arrayNextLevelIndex range, [0x1a]=SubPageID, [0x1b]=strSubPageTitle key, [0x1e/0x1f]=star/priority sort keys
isReward = *(byte*)(elem+7); isReward reward id resolved via FUN_10976e80 (CLevelRewardInfo grid) then FUN_10976ff0
'best/highlight' level pick: keeps elem with higher [0x1f] (or equal [0x1f] and higher pppppiStack_174 vs [0x1e]) when [0xc]==0 (unlocked)
functions.serverRelevance: client-only: UI list builder reading server-authoritative CMHLevelInfo config and unlock/reward state.

functions.purpose: Scans all hubs (outer) and up to 32 chapters (inner) to find the first unclaimed hub-completion reward and reports it to UI (hubId, chapterInfo, numReward, rewardId, stateReward). If none pending, reports terminal state 2.
formulas: outer loop bound = FUN_10976b80() (hub count); hub obj = FUN_10976af0(hubIdx); inner loop 0..0x20 (32) chapters; chapter = FUN_116b8a70(i)
rewardId = hubObj->vtbl[+0x18](chapter+4, &iStack_54); reward state iStack_50 = FUN_1130c880(playerLevelObj local_2c, rewardId)
emit when rewardId>0 (iStack_54>0) && state!=1: stateReward = (rewardId==-1)?0:1; else if all hubs exhausted (hubCount<=hubIdx): report chapterInfo=-1, rewardId=-1, stateReward=2
iStack_50 init -5 sentinel; state==1 means already claimed
functions.serverRelevance: validation: client computes which reward to show/request; server must authoritatively decide claim eligibility (state) and grant. Client display of stateReward is advisory.

functions.purpose: Builds an ITEM_VO itemList view-object (param_5==2) by scanning the player's bag across bag types {0,2,10} and matching items whose base-item id equals a target material id (from FUN_11669250 -> +0x10). Writes per-item VO fields: id, count, asset, collumn(slot), isBind, m_nBindType, m_nFactItemLevel, and if transmogrify-capable m_nTransmogrifyItemId + quench fields.
formulas: bag-type set auStack_18 = {0, 2, 10}; per type slotCount = FUN_113f92a0(type); item = FUN_113f9bb0(type, slotIdx)
match: candidate base id (from op-struct +0x10 via FUN_11669250) == target; count via item->vtbl[+0xc]()
isBind = (piVar3[8] != 0); m_nBindType = FUN_116693d0(); m_nFactItemLevel = item->vtbl[+0x18]()

quench block only if FUN_116698a0()!=0 (transmog-capable): m_nTransmogrifyItemId = piVar3[0x7d]; item def via FUN_1052bdd0; m_bCanQuench = (def+0x28c != 0); m_nMaxQuenchLevel = def+0x290; m_nQuenchLevel = (short)piVar3[0x7e]
functions.serverRelevance: client-only: read-only bag view builder; bag contents are server-authoritative.

functions.purpose: Builds an ITEM_VO itemList (param_5==5) scanning bag types {0,2,10} filtered by item category fields (rareType iStack_78 at def+0x34, typeNormal piStack_74 at def+0x38, typeSub iStack_a0/iStack_7c at def+0x3c). Emits richer VO incl. m_typeNormal, m_typeSub, m_nRareType.
formulas: bag types {0,2,10}; slotCount=FUN_113f92a0(type); item=FUN_113f9bb0(type,slot)

filter: (iStack_78<0 || iStack_78==def+0x34) && (piStack_74<0 || piStack_74==def+0x38); typeSub match: if iStack_7c==-1 use iStack_a0==def+0x3c; else if iStack_a0>=0 && iStack_a0!=def+0x3c && iStack_7c>=0 use iStack_7c==def+0x3c
sentinel -0x21524151 (0xDEADBEAF-like) marks 'no filter'; def field offsets +0x10(id) +0x34(rareType) +0x38(typeNormal) +0x3c(typeSub) +0xb4(asset) +0x4c(rareType alt)
quench fields identical to 1097fd80 (m_bCanQuench def+0x28c, m_nMaxQuenchLevel def+0x290, m_nQuenchLevel (short)piVar3[0x7e]); m_nRareType from item->vtbl[+0x2c]() when transmog-capable else def+0x4c
functions.serverRelevance: client-only: bag view builder with category filter; contents server-authoritative.

functions.purpose: Builds the mh.model.Ipvp.IpvpSettlementData VO after an interactive-PvP match: per-player rows (level, name, score, catcar), reward Items list, and league (排位) result: score/power deltas, coin change, faction, rank-band transition and pictures.
formulas: player-row array stride = 0x430 bytes; row count = (list_end[+0x64] - list_begin[+0x60]) / 0x430; self row matched by row+4 == myId(iStack_f4+4)
RedTeamScore=battle+0x54, BlueTeamScore=battle+0x58, PlayerLevel=self+0x408, Score=self+0x40c, CatCar=self+0x414
league fields read from player+0x9880.. : LeagueType=[0x9880], LeagueScoreChange=[0x9881], LeaguePowerChange=[0x9882], LeagueSelfScoreChange/CoinChange=[0x9883]; [0x9884..0x988a] rank/pic state
LeagueCoinCurrent = FUN_1025b060(); LeagueCoinChange = iStack_c8 ([0x9883])

rank-band (LeagueType==4 only): tier = score/100 + 1; iStack_d0 = maxScore/100+1, iVar7 = curScore/100+1; LeagueCurSelRankScore = (maxScore/100+1)*100 - maxScore (points to next band); band-transition code: ==->1, cur<prev->3, prev<cur->2, else 0
Items list built from in_stack_00000018 pairs {id, count} stride 4 dwords as BaseItemVo(id,count)
costs: LeagueCoinCurrent snapshot = FUN_1025b060(); LeagueCoinChange = league coin delta awarded this match (server-computed)
functions.serverRelevance: client-only: settlement UI. All scores, coin deltas, reward Items and rank transitions are server-authoritative; this function only renders them.

functions.purpose: Builds LEVELENTRUST_DETAILVO by (nGroupID,nSubGroupID,nLevelID) (param_5==4). If all three are 0, resolves the current active entrust (mgr+0x2b9c) else uses args. Writes accept state, current/max entrust counts, medal descriptions, title, target area, limit time, need-item, reward placeholders, and other-target array.
formulas: arg parse: group=in+8(if type 3/4), subGroup=in+0x20, levelID=in+0x38; else default group=0xdeadbeaf sentinel
bIsAccept = (activeEntrust(+0xae7 obj)->[10](0) exists && its +8 == nLevelID)
curEntrustCount = (+0xae6 obj)->vtbl[10]()
maxEntrustCount = base->[0xb] + titleBonus, where titleBonus = mgr(local_10c+0x2b98)->vtbl[+0x20](titleObj, entrustCfg[0xc]) (0x10986502 area)
nLimitTime = *(entrustCfg+0x24)+0x40; needItemId=*(FUN_116ae260(3)+4), needItemCount=+8
nRewardUnBindGold / nRewardBindGold / nRewardExp all written 0 (client placeholders; real reward server-side)
strOtherTargetArr: iterates entrust other-target list, element stride = 0x54 bytes, count = (list+0x20 - list+0x1c)/0x54; medal desc block gated by FUN_116ae4c0 && FUN_1175b200(1)
costs: needItemId/needItemCount = commission material requirement (FUN_116ae260(3)); reward gold/exp displayed as 0 here (populated server-side elsewhere)
functions.serverRelevance: validation/client-only: entrust detail UI; accept eligibility, counts and rewards are server-authoritative. maxEntrustCount = base + title bonus is a useful server rule to mirror.
